title: Blue Tablecloth
style: Cool jazz ballad with laid-back swung 78 BPM, brushed snare and upright bass carrying the pulse, muted trumpet answering sparse piano chords and Fender Rhodes comping; verse stays intimate and low-lit, pre-chorus opens with tenor sax counterline, chorus leans into close-mic doubled vocals with plate reverb and soft ad-libs. Tape saturation, brushed transients, and a warm nocturne mix give it a worn velvet glow., ballad, swing, jazz, cool jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your cup still marks the ring
on that blue tablecloth
I trace the faded stain
where your hand used to fall

The sugar jar is half full
the spoon is bent to side
I hear your laugh in the glass
then it slips away

[Pre-Chorus]
And I keep the chair
pulled a little close
like you might come back
for one more note

[Chorus]
Stay with me tonight
stay with me tonight
Old flame in my chest
won’t say goodbye

Stay with me tonight
stay with me tonight
The room knows your name
and so do I

[Verse 2]
The rain taps on the pane
like fingers on the keys
Your coat still by the door
smells faintly of the sea

I saved a little change
from every hard goodnight
Now I spend it on the dark
and call it passing time

[Pre-Chorus]
And I keep the chair
pulled a little close
like you might come back
for one more note

[Chorus]
Stay with me tonight
stay with me tonight
Old flame in my chest
won’t say goodbye

Stay with me tonight
stay with me tonight
The room knows your name
and so do I

[Bridge]
If I let the lights go low
I can almost see
your hands above the glass
your smile reaching me

But morning takes its coat
and folds it into gray
Still I hear your last soft step
walking down the hall away

[Chorus]
Stay with me tonight
stay with me tonight
Old flame in my chest
won’t say goodbye

Stay with me tonight
stay with me tonight
The room knows your name
and so do I
